attempts.result: Established entry-argument and shared/input-holder demand origins with explicit candidate-typed and dynamic-feasibility limits. No source-level boolean-caching candidate was established.

Hypothesis not established. A decoded entry path reaches 0x1508 while avoiding 0xaf8 entirely; therefore 0xaf8 nonzero fallthrough 0xb00 is not necessary. The proposed 0x1508 zero-edge infeasibility condition is false. Both 0x1508 and 0x18e8 retain static paths to old-zero.

observed_constraints.statement: Static memcmp call counts are original 14, canonical 15, and natural-closure 16. Actual memcmp virtual addresses are original 0x1b3678, canonical 0x1b59d8, and natural 0x1b6ad0. The earlier original 0x1b4bd8 address was a file-offset/virtual-address mix-up.
Original old-key memcmp at relative 0x1940 reads bonding_curve.creator, not current_creator.key. Natural old-zero calls at 0x1848 and 0x1a78 read that same creator origin.

Natural target-zero sites 0x5b8 and 0xab0 are branch-specialized incoming-new payload and derived holder-key comparisons; they do not establish two comparisons on one dynamic path. Original has one merged selected-target comparison.

Additional original origins bounded by the corrected pass: quote comparison 0x340 reads curve quote_mint; early -0x518 at 0xd10 is the holder-rewards PDA copy and is later reused for a distinct creator-vault PDA at 0x1f30; -0x470 at 0xd58 comes from the sharing-config account key.

Original cleanup is 0x5868 result-pointer load, 0x5870/0x5878 writes, and 0x5880 exit. 0x5868 has 25 decoded predecessors; 0x5870 also has entry 0x5470 with the result pointer already in r4. Natural cleanup is 0x3148, 0x3150/0x3158, and 0x3160 exit; 0x3148 has 32 predecessors and 0x3150 only one. Both already share final error cleanup.

Original r6 at 0x1c78/0x1c80 merges default false definitions with the old-key memcmp result, but queried later r6 guards have independent definitions. Direct late-r6 old-boolean reuse is unsupported; this does not decide source-level old_nondefault reuse. Original static old-zero site 0x1940 cannot loop back to itself in the decoded CFG.

Original 0x1508 and direct -0x928 demand at 0x1500 each have exactly one terminal, entry r4; natural 0xaf8 and 0x3670 also trace to entry r4. Candidate typed LLVM uses %1 as Option<u64> fee discriminant and %2 as payload. This supports a fee-tag role for -0x928, not a holder-byte role, without proving original source or assigning machine registers from the LLVM signature.

Original shared branches 0x1120 and 0x1820 have only definitions 0x1d0=0 and 0x270=xor r0,1, bounding them to the early shared boolean established by creator/sharing-key, owner, and data-empty checks.

Original r8 at 0x1840 traces to entry r3; candidate typed %0 is packed Option<bool> holder. This supports an input-holder condition distinct from the curve is_holder_reward byte loaded at 0x18e0 and tested at 0x18e8.

Post-wallet r3 at 0x1990 and 0x1d40 has definitions 0x1198=0, 0x1898=1, 0x18c0=1, and 0x1958=1. Shared-zero reaches r3=1 through 0x18b0; shared-nonzero with r8=0 reaches r3=1 through 0x1850; shared-nonzero with r8!=0 reaches 0x1138 and r3=0. The old-zero block also sets r3=1 at 0x1958. These facts bound a combined shared/input-holder guard but do not recover a source expression.

Neither early target-selection arm 0x648 nor 0x900 reaches 0x1508 when 0x18e8 is forbidden, so the alternate 0x1508-to-0x18f8 edge is not a proven direct early bypass of the holder-byte test. The sharper feasibility pass then showed that 0x1508 is reachable from entry while avoiding 0xaf8 entirely; no universal holder or non-holder claim follows.

Typed canonical bb286 is a 20-predecessor error-staging block and bb288 has five predecessors. Their exact machine predecessor-role mapping remains open and cannot be inferred from predecessor count alone.

candidate_results.gains_losses_note: Not applicable: no lane source candidate was built or scored. Empty gain/loss claims would falsely imply a scored candidate.

this_lane: Treating original 0x1b4bd8 as memcmp VA: rejected as an address-domain error.
Stack-provenance v1 CFG: rejected because branch offsets were decoded incorrectly; all of its CFG conclusions are void.
Assigning original old-key memcmp to current_creator.key: contradicted by direct stack provenance to bonding_curve.creator.
Treating natural 0x5b8 and 0xab0 as two target comparisons on one dynamic path: rejected by branch specialization.
Deleting the validation closure merely to recreate a two-level cleanup join: unjustified because both original and natural already share cleanup.
Direct late-r6 reuse of the old comparison boolean: unsupported by actual-CFG demand tracing; source-level boolean reuse remains a separate question.
Proving 0x1508 zero-edge infeasibility from a necessary 0xaf8 nonzero fallthrough: rejected because an entry path avoids 0xaf8 entirely.
Using body size as a near-match claim: not used.

unresolved_cfg_and_data_provenance: Exact dynamic predecessor history and value feasibility of original 0x1508 remain open. Both 0x1508 and 0x18e8 have static paths to old-zero, and the failed necessary-edge shortcut does not resolve holder feasibility.

The 0x1500/0x1508 entry-r4 demands cross ten decoded calls. Direct absence of an r10-0x928 address escape is insufficient to exclude callee aliasing; any stronger runtime invariance claim needs a complete alias audit or must retain this caveat.

Original source-level reuse of old != Pubkey::default() across wallet and the later !shared condition is unproved. Natural has two static old-zero sites; original has one static site, which is suggestive only.

The precise source expression for the combined shared/input-holder post-wallet guard is unrecovered; decoded definitions and path roles do not prove source syntax or feasibility of every value combination.
Complete typed pointer provenance for original selected-target -0x4b8 at 0xcc8 remains open; unaligned direct copies require pointer-phi analysis.
Exact predecessor-role mapping among original cleanup, natural cleanup, and typed canonical bb286/bb288 remains open.
Candidate typed LLVM is corroboration for entry/value roles only; it is not recovered original source and does not authorize machine-register inference from its function signature.
